title: Step 4 - Applying the Same Scaler to Training and Test Sets in Python

cues.en: Instructor: All right, great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So this will apply feature scaling to our two columns of the training set.
cues.zh: 這樣就會縮放訓練集的這兩個欄位。

cues.en: And now I hope you know what the next step is going to be, and you won't fall into the trap.
cues.zh: 希望你知道接下來要做什麼，也不會掉進陷阱。

cues.en: Now we have to also transform our matrix of features of the test set, meaning x_test this matrix of features.
cues.zh: 現在還要轉換測試集特徵矩陣，也就是 X_test。

cues.en: But since this data is like new data, which we get, you know, later on in production, well, for this data I will only apply the transform method
cues.zh: 但這些資料就像未來正式環境才取得的新資料，所以只會使用 transform，

cues.en: because indeed the features of the test set need to be scaled by the same scaler that was used on the training set.
cues.zh: 因為測試集必須使用訓練集所採用的同一個縮放器。

cues.en: We cannot get a new scaler.
cues.zh: 不能建立新的縮放器。

cues.en: You know, if we applied the fit transform method here on x_test, we would get a new scaler.
cues.zh: 如果對 X_test 使用 fit_transform，就會得到新的縮放器。

cues.en: And that would absolutely not make sense, because x_test will actually be the input of the predict function that will return the predictions, you know, after the machine learning model is trained.
cues.zh: 這完全不合理，因為模型訓練完成後，X_test 會被傳入 predict 來取得預測。

cues.en: And since this machine learning model will be trained with a particular scaler, you know, the scaler applied on the training set, well, in order to make predictions that will be congruent
cues.zh: 模型是用特定縮放器，也就是訓練集的縮放器來訓練，因此為了讓預測資料

cues.en: with the way the model was trained, well, we need to apply the same scaler that was used on the training set onto the test set, so that we can get indeed the same transformation,
cues.zh: 與訓練方式一致，必須把訓練集的同一個縮放器套用到測試集，得到相同轉換，

cues.en: and therefore in the end, some relevant predictions with the predict method applied to x_test.
cues.zh: 最後再對 X_test 呼叫 predict，才會產生合理預測。

cues.en: So here, it's clearly the transform method that must only be applied, and therefore, what we're gonna do to make it efficient, well, we're gonna copy this line of code,
cues.zh: 所以這裡只能用 transform。為了方便，先複製這行程式，

cues.en: and just, you know, we're gonna paste it.
cues.zh: 再貼上。

cues.en: We're gonna replace, of course, x_train by x_test, and then here as well, x_train by x_test.
cues.zh: 把 X_train 換成 X_test，這裡同樣改成 X_test。

cues.en: And then just call, of course, the transform method from that same scaler that was applied on the training set.
cues.zh: 再從訓練集使用的同一個縮放器，呼叫 transform。

cues.en: Because indeed, this is part of the training, right?
cues.zh: 因為這其實是訓練的一部分。

cues.en: Even if we haven't started the training, well, this operation that we apply here on our training set is, you know, the preparation of the training.
cues.zh: 雖然還沒正式訓練模型，但對訓練集做的這些操作，就是訓練準備。

cues.en: All right? So I hope it's clear.
cues.zh: 希望這樣很清楚。

cues.en: It's very important that you understand this.
cues.zh: 請務必理解。

cues.en: And now, well, I have to say congratulations, because we're actually done implementing our final tool.
cues.zh: 恭喜，我們已完成最後一項工具。

cues.en: And of course, I'm going to show you the result of feature scaling here.
cues.zh: 當然，也會展示特徵縮放的結果。

cues.en: So let me create two more code cells, inside which we're gonna print first x_train, and then, let me copy this,
cues.zh: 新增兩個程式儲存格，先輸出 X_train，再複製這裡，

cues.en: and then we're gonna print x_test.
cues.zh: 接著輸出 X_test。

cues.en: All right, perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So let's first run this to apply feature scaling.
cues.zh: 先執行這裡，套用特徵縮放。

cues.en: Perfect, there we go, no execution error.
cues.zh: 好了，沒有執行錯誤。

cues.en: Then let's print x_train.
cues.zh: 再輸出 X_train。

cues.en: And of course we get, well, still the same values for the dummy variables, which are indeed still between minus three and plus three.
cues.zh: 虛擬變數仍保持原值，也仍然位於 -3 到 +3 之間。

cues.en: But then, our age and salary variables were transformed, so that they take new values between minus two and plus two.
cues.zh: 但年齡與薪資已經轉換，現在落在 -2 到 +2 之間。

cues.en: Sometimes you will see values between minus three and plus three.
cues.zh: 有時會看到 -3 到 +3 的值。

cues.en: Here, it's minus two and plus two.
cues.zh: 這裡則是 -2 到 +2。

cues.en: But anyway, now all our variables are on the same scale and this will be perfect to improve or optimize the training of certain machine learning models.
cues.zh: 無論如何，現在所有變數都位於相同尺度，有助於改善或最佳化某些模型的訓練。

cues.en: And of course you will see exactly which ones they're gonna be the further we progress in this machine learning course.
cues.zh: 隨著課程進行，你會知道哪些模型需要這麼做。

cues.en: So now you know everything.
cues.zh: 現在都清楚了。

cues.en: Let's also execute this cell to print x_test.
cues.zh: 再執行這格，輸出 X_test。

cues.en: And once again, well, you still have your dummy variables here, for the same two customers that were here, but then the age and the salary were scaled so that they take once again values
cues.zh: 同樣地，這兩位測試客戶的虛擬變數保持原樣，但年齡與薪資已經縮放，數值也落在

cues.en: between minus two and plus two.
All right. Okay, so great.
